messages:
alex: Pinging team — I opened a docs PR to harmonize the Console observability snippets and clean up a couple of broken links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/478
marie: Nice, which files are affected? can you drop the paths so I can do a quick scan?
alex: Sure — top-level changes are in the console section. main ones:
- docs/console/tracing/hooks.md (replaced node example with unified SDK call)
- docs/console/dashboards/cost-latency.md (added token-level cost breakdown example)
- docs/snippets/sdk/node/tracing-sample.js and docs/snippets/sdk/py/tracing_sample.py
- docs/console/upgrade/migration-v1-to-v2.md (added short migration checklist)
jen: thanks. do we have test snippets that actually run? last time some of the node snippets were missing imports.
alex: I corrected imports and added a tiny runnable sample for both Node and Python. Node example now starts with `const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference')` and the tracehook shim is `redwood.trace('span', {})` (example only).
matt: can you paste the two-line diff for the tracehook change? I want to confirm it won't break our quickstart.
alex: paste: ```diff
- redwood.traceHook.start({id: 'foo'})
+ redwood.trace('foo', {attrs: {service: 'console'}})
```
marie: Good call adding migration note. Suggest we add a short example showing how cost attribution fields map between the old trace schema and the new one (token_cost -> unit_cost, latency_ms -> latency).
alex: Added a small table in `migration-v1-to-v2.md` and a one-liner snippet: `span.meta = {unit_cost: 0.002, latency: 12}` — it's intentionally tiny so we don't bloat the page.
jen: I found two dead links in the dashboard page that your PR touches: one to `docs/metrics/legacy-widget.md` and another to `docs/examples/kv-cache.md`. The PR replaces them with the canonical references.
docs-bot: PR #478 updated: labels: docs, needs-review, sdk-snippets — assigned to @marie
marie: I'll take the first pass. can someone add a small E2E check? maybe a CI job that `node ./docs/snippets/sdk/node/tracing-sample.js` exits 0.
matt: I can add a minimal check into `ci/docs-validate.sh` to run the node and python snippets. quick script: `node -e "require('./docs/snippets/sdk/node/tracing-sample.js')"` and `python3 -c "import runpy; runpy.run_path('docs/snippets/sdk/py/tracing_sample.py')"`
alex: That would be awesome. Also flagged a non-blocking UX note: cost breakdown example assumes `token_count` metric is present in the trace payload. I added a note to default to `0` if missing.
jen: One tiny wording nit: the dashboard doc uses "latency SLO" in one place and "latency SLA" in another. pick one. Suggest SLO.
alex: Switched to SLO everywhere in the PR.
marie: After my review I'll suggest a couple copy tweaks and then merge, unless someone raises objections.
matt: No objections from infra. I'll add the CI snippet in a follow-up PR and link it in the PR description.
jen: Thanks — can we also add a short snippet for the Console UI showing how to toggle trace/metrics overlays? just a 2-line snippet in the dashboard page.
alex: Added a tiny UI snippet: `Console.showOverlay('trace')` — purely illustrative.
marie: Reviewing now. aim to finish by EOD PST.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs owners ping at 1754444000
alex: Thanks all. If anyone hits deadlink warnings locally run `scripts/docs-link-check` — I patched the link whitelist to ignore the old marketplace URLs for now.
matt: noted. will follow up after adding CI snippet.
